events.summary: Hello, Knights! Thank you for continuing to share your feedback, bug reports and gameplay recordings. events.title: Enter the Apocalypse - Knights of the Fall Demo Is Now Available!
events.summary: Hello, Knights! The world has fallen. Earth is stranded in another dimension. Armed with a katana and the ability to manipulate time and gravity, Haru must fight to find a way home. For the first time ever, the DEMO of Knights of the Fall is now publicly available on Steam as part of Steam Next Fest! events.title: Announcing Knights of the Fall – A Sci-Fi Journey Beyond Dimensions
events.summary: Hello everyone, We’re thrilled to finally introduce Knights of the Fall – a sci-fi 2D/3D hybrid platformer that follows the story of Haru, a combat veteran, and Yoshida, his scientist sidekick, as they uncover the dark connection between interdimensional travel and the afterlife.
